validations.name: Report approvable
validations.message: Report {form.REPORT_ID} is not awaiting a decision (status {form.STATUS}).

business_logic.description: Block action unless the report is awaiting a decision
business_logic.spec: Payload is the EXPTRACK_EXPENSE_REPORT header row (flat). Read STATUS. If STATUS is not the awaiting-decision value ('Pending' - the submitted state as defined by the allowed values on EXPTRACK_EXPENSE_REPORT.STATUS), return an error string stating the report has already been decided and cannot be approved or rejected. If APPROVER_COMMENTS is blank and the decision being recorded is a rejection, the reject action's own validation handles that. Return NULL/None when the report is still awaiting a decision.

Payload is the EXPTRACK_EXPENSE_REPORT row (flat, includes REPORT_ID, STATUS, APPROVER_COMMENTS). Refuse with {"error": ...} unless STATUS is the awaiting-decision value 'Pending'. Otherwise UPDATE EXPTRACK_EXPENSE_REPORT SET STATUS='Approved', APPROVER = the logged-in approver's display name, APPROVAL_DATE = current date/time, PAYMENT_STATUS='Pending', APPROVER_COMMENTS = the submitted comments when supplied, CHG_DATE = current date/time WHERE REPORT_ID = the payload REPORT_ID. Then propagate the outcome to the lines: UPDATE EXPTRACK_EXPENSE SET STATUS='Approved', APPROVAL_STATUS='Approved', CHG_DATE = current date/time WHERE EXPENSE_REPORT = the REPORT_ID. Return {"message": "Report <REPORT_ID> approved."}.

validations.name: Must be awaiting decision
validations.message: Only reports awaiting a decision can be approved (report {form.REPORT_ID} is {form.STATUS}).

business_logic.spec: Payload is the EXPTRACK_EXPENSE_REPORT row (flat). Refuse with {"error": ...} unless STATUS is the awaiting-decision value 'Pending', and refuse when APPROVER_COMMENTS is blank (comments are mandatory on reject). Otherwise UPDATE EXPTRACK_EXPENSE_REPORT SET STATUS='Rejected', APPROVER = the logged-in approver's display name, APPROVAL_DATE = current date/time, APPROVER_COMMENTS = the submitted comments, CHG_DATE = current date/time WHERE REPORT_ID = the payload REPORT_ID. Leave PAYMENT_STATUS untouched. Then propagate: UPDATE EXPTRACK_EXPENSE SET STATUS='Rejected', APPROVAL_STATUS='Rejected', APPROVER_COMMENTS = the same comments, CHG_DATE = current date/time WHERE EXPENSE_REPORT = the REPORT_ID. Return {"message": "Report <REPORT_ID> rejected."}.

validations.name: Must be awaiting decision
validations.message: Only reports awaiting a decision can be rejected (report {form.REPORT_ID} is {form.STATUS}).

validations.name: Comments mandatory on reject
validations.message: Approver comments are mandatory when rejecting a report.
